articles.headline: Ramayana Box Office Day 15: Nitesh Tiwari's Epic Nears Rs 1,600 Crore With 3.4 Crore Tickets Sold
articles.dek: Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash's mythological epic Ramayana continues a phenomenal theatrical journey, inching towards the Rs 1,600-crore milestone globally after strong collections on its fifteenth day.

p: Nitesh Tiwari's directorial venture Ramayana has maintained an impressive momentum at the global box office, closing in on the Rs 1,600-crore threshold during its fifteenth day in cinemas. The mythological drama accumulated an estimated 9,28,188 ticket sales over the course of the day, lifting its overall cumulative admissions to an impressive 3,48,95,085 tickets sold since release.

On its fifteenth day, the feature brought in Rs 19.35 crore nett domestically across India. This pushed its cumulative domestic nett collection to Rs 863.75 crore, while its overall India gross reached Rs 1,032.15 crore alongside robust contributions from international territories.

According to tracking data from Sacnilk, the magnum opus was screened across 21,437 shows in five different languages throughout India on Friday. The Hindi version drove the majority of the domestic day-15 figures with Rs 14 crore, followed by the Malayalam version at Rs 1.75 crore, Tamil at Rs 1.50 crore, Kannada at Rs 1.40 crore, and Telugu contributing Rs 70 lakh.

The Hindi 3D format registered an average occupancy rate of 15.77% on its fifteenth day. Morning screenings started at 7.62% occupancy, climbing to 14.69% in the afternoon, before peaking during the evening and night shows which recorded 20.46% and 20.31% theatre occupancy respectively.

With worldwide gross collections touching Rs 1,547.15 crore, Ramayana currently holds the position of the fifth-highest-grossing Indian film globally. The upper tiers of the list feature Dangal at the top with Rs 2,070 crore, followed by Dhurandhar 2 at Rs 1,813.40 crore, Baahubali 2 at Rs 1,788 crore, and Pushpa 2 at Rs 1,742 crore.

Significantly, the film achieved the Rs 1,500-crore milestone faster than any preceding Indian movie. It surpassed the mark ahead of Dhurandhar 2, which took 16 days, as well as Pushpa 2, Baahubali 2, and Dangal, which required 17, 20, and 30 days respectively.

body.h: Milestones Across Domestic And Overseas Terrains
p: Ramayana previously became the sixth Indian film to cross Rs 1,000 crore in domestic gross earnings. Its second weekend brought in Rs 196 crore nett across languages, breaking the previous second-weekend benchmark of Rs 172.70 crore held by Dhurandhar 2.

Internationally, the film cleared $25 million in North America, establishing itself as the second Bollywood release after Dhurandhar 2 to cross the figure in that territory and overtaking Baahubali 2 in the region.

The production marked the highest opening-day collections for its principal cast members Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and director Nitesh Tiwari. Its opening-day domestic nett total of Rs 64.85 crore outpaced the Rs 63.80 crore generated by Ranbir's Animal.

Furthermore, the project became the first Bollywood release to gross over Rs 50 crore individually across all four major southern markets of Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh-Telangana, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala, completing the milestone in Tamil Nadu on its fourteenth day.

Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana has neared the Rs 1,600-crore worldwide box office mark on its 15th day with total ticket sales reaching 3.4 crore. Starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, the film earned Rs 19.35 crore nett in India on Day 15, bringing its cumulative global collections to Rs 1,547.15 crore and solidifying its status as the fifth-highest-grossing Indian film worldwide.

articles.headline: Lanterns Sets 2027 Physical Media Release Amid DCU Leadership Changes
articles.dek: Warner Bros. Home Entertainment has officially scheduled the acclaimed sci-fi series Lanterns for a February 2027 physical release across 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray, and DVD formats.

p: Warner Bros. Home Entertainment has officially scheduled Lanterns: The Complete First Season to arrive on physical media, offering fans a chance to own the acclaimed series on 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray, and DVD. The home video package is set to launch on February 9, 2027, with the UK release scheduled a day earlier on February 8, 2027.

The physical release comes as a significant win for collectors who prefer owning physical copies over relying solely on digital vaults and subscription paywalls. Pre-orders have already gone live across major retailers, which includes a Limited Edition 4K Steelbook option for collectors based in the UK.

Distributed across three discs, the 4K UHD edition presents all eight hour-long episodes in pristine 2160p resolution with a 2.00:1 aspect ratio. Furthermore, the home video collection preserves the original series' Dolby Atmos surround sound mix to maintain its immersive audio quality.

In addition to the eight episodes, the physical release features 'Inside the Episode' featurettes that break down the creative decisions behind the production. The three-disc set also includes a slate of exclusive special features tailored specifically for the home-entertainment release alongside optional English SDH subtitles.

The standard Blu-ray release will be housed in a sleek slipcover that prominently features a large Green Lantern emblem. The artwork places the story's intergalactic law enforcement officers directly in the foreground, making it an attractive display piece for franchise enthusiasts.

Physical media collectors and DC enthusiasts now have a tangible way to preserve the debut season of the cosmic crime thriller. This release offers a rare opportunity to secure a physical copy of the show while the broader franchise navigates its current transition period.

The grounded sci-fi drama originally launched on HBO Max in August to massive critical acclaim from viewers and reviewers alike. Its narrative follows Kyle Chandler as Hal Jordan and Aaron Pierre as John Stewart as they investigate a complex murder case situated in the Nebraska heartland.

What begins as a localized murder investigation soon pulls the two intergalactic cops into a much wider and deeper mystery. The eight-episode run successfully established a gritty tone for the cosmic crime thriller before concluding its initial streaming broadcast.

body.h: DCU Leadership Changes and Season 2 Uncertainties
p: The future of the broader DC Universe remains uncertain following the shocking exits of James Gunn and Peter Safran from their leadership positions. Under the incoming regime led by incoming DC Studios chief creative officer Jeremy Latcham and Skydance, the trajectory of several projects is currently being re-evaluated.

Showrunner Chris Mundy recently addressed the possibility of a second season, candidly describing the renewal odds as a coin flip or a fifty-fifty chance. Despite the lack of an official greenlight from the studio at this stage, Mundy remains hopeful that the narrative involving Hal Jordan and John Stewart is not yet finished.

The series features a sprawling ensemble cast led by Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre alongside notable performers such as Kelly Macdonald, Garret Dillahunt, Poorna Jagannathan, Jason Ritter, Chris Coy, J. Alphonse Nicholson, Cary Christopher, Shea Pritchard, Ulrich Thomsen, and Nathan Fillion.

Creative oversight for the project involved a talented group of creators and showrunners, including Chris Mundy, Damon Lindelof, and Tom King. Directing duties across the first season were handled by filmmakers Alik Sakharov, James Hawes, Stephen Williams, and Geeta Patel, with writing contributions from Vanessa Baden Kelly, Justin Britt-Gibson, and Breannah Gibson.

Warner Bros. Home Entertainment has announced that the first season of Lanterns will release on 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray, and DVD on February 9, 2027. While the physical release preserves all eight episodes and includes special features, the show's potential second season remains uncertain following leadership changes at DC Studios.

articles.headline: Bachelor Party Deux Box Office Collection Day 1: Naslen and Kunchacko Boban Starrer Earns Rs 2.55 Cr Net
articles.dek: Amal Neerad's latest directorial venture, Bachelor Party Deux, opened to decent figures at the box office, raking in Rs 2.55 crore net in India on its first day, with Kerala leading the charge.

p: The action entertainer Bachelor Party Deux kicked off its theatrical run with an opening-day India net collection of Rs 2.55 crore on Thursday, November 19. Directed by Amal Neerad, the feature film also pulled in a domestic gross collection of Rs 3 crore on its very first day in cinemas.

Across all reported language versions, the movie was screened through a total of 1,516 shows. Industry trackers noted that the feature achieved an overall theatre occupancy of roughly 40 percent during its opening-day screenings.

The Malayalam version of Bachelor Party Deux drove the vast majority of the film's financial success, generating Rs 2.52 crore from 1,282 screenings. This accounted for a dominant 98.8 percent of the total domestic net earnings.
Conversely, the Telugu release contributed a much smaller share, adding Rs 3 lakh across 234 shows to make up the remaining 1.2 percent of the overall domestic net collection.

Viewer turnout varied across different languages and time slots on opening day. The Malayalam version enjoyed an overall theatre occupancy of 46 percent, peaking during night screenings with a strong 49.50 percent attendance rate. Morning, afternoon, and evening shows recorded 31.67 percent, 30.83 percent, and 34.67 percent occupancy respectively.
The Telugu 2D version recorded an overall occupancy of 7 percent, while the Tamil 2D version averaged an overall occupancy of 10.38 percent, seeing its highest numbers during the evening screenings.

body.h: Geographical Contribution and Dominance of Kerala
p: Domestic gross collections highlighted a heavy reliance on the home market. Kerala single-handedly drove the numbers, contributing Rs 2.60 crore and accounting for 86.7 percent of the tracked gross collection.

Other regional markets trailed behind significantly. Karnataka brought in Rs 22 lakh, Tamil Nadu contributed Rs 8 lakh, and Andhra Pradesh alongside Telangana combined for Rs 5 lakh, with miscellaneous Indian markets adding another Rs 5 lakh.

Bachelor Party Deux is positioned as a spiritual successor to the 2012 Malayalam film Bachelor Party. Helmed by director Amal Neerad, the movie boasts a large ensemble cast filled with prominent names from the Malayalam film industry.

The leading roles are headlined by Naslen K. Gafoor, Kunchacko Boban, Tovino Thomas, and Soubin Shahir. They are supported by a talented supporting roster that includes Sharafudheen, Sreenath Bhasi, Shine Tom Chacko, and Nadhiya.

The strong initial performance underscores a concentrated audience base in Kerala. As the action-packed feature enters its first weekend, trade analysts and makers will be watching closely to see if the film can sustain its momentum.
Industry observers note that future days will determine whether the title can successfully expand its reach and draw crowds beyond its core regional market.
Amal Neerad's action entertainer Bachelor Party Deux debuted with Rs 2.55 crore in India net earnings and a domestic gross of Rs 3 crore on its opening day.
The Malayalam version powered the vast majority of the box office performance, with Kerala contributing the largest share of the regional collections.

articles.headline: Vijay Antony's Wife Shares Moving Details About His Life After Their Daughter's Passing
articles.dek: At a recent promotional event for Appa Kutty, Fatima revealed how actor-composer Vijay Antony stopped wearing shoes and continues to wear his late daughter Meera's watch.

body.h: A Public Appearance and Emotional Revelation
p: Multi-hyphenate artist Vijay Antony recently stepped out alongside his wife, Fatima, and their younger daughter, Lara, to promote his upcoming cinematic project. The family gathering marked a rare public outing for them since the devastating loss of their elder daughter, Meera, three years ago.

During the pre-release promotional gathering for the film, Fatima opened up candidly about the profound grief that has continuously reshaped their household. Her touching remarks shed light on the personal coping mechanisms and quiet tributes her husband has maintained in the wake of the tragedy.

body.h: The Choice to Give Up Footwear
p: Among the most striking details shared by Fatima was the reason behind Vijay Antony's decision to stop wearing shoes in his daily life. She explained that over the years, the family had collected numerous pairs of footwear for Meera from travels to places like London and the United States.

These accumulated items eventually filled an entire room in their home. Upon seeing those unused shoes, the actor and filmmaker made the emotional choice to abandon wearing everyday footwear, reserving shoes strictly for specific international concerts.

body.h: A Constant Memory on His Wrist
p: In addition to altering his daily wardrobe habits, Vijay Antony has held onto a singular physical keepsake belonging to his late daughter. Fatima disclosed that despite having access to several luxury timepieces, her husband wears only one specific watch every single day.
This particular watch belonged to Meera and was worn on her wrist the very last time the father saw her. According to his wife, he has not removed the timepiece since that heartbreaking day.

body.h: Reflecting on Personal Bonds and Support
p: During her address at the event, Fatima also reflected on her own past and the parallels of familial support she found later in life. She shared that her own father had left her family when she was just seven years old.
Years later, she found that missing emotional backing and steadfast companionship in her husband. She credited Vijay Antony as the person who ultimately provided her with that enduring love.

Meera tragically passed away on September 19, 2023, at the age of 16, when she was found dead at the family's residence in Chennai. The sudden loss sent shockwaves through the industry and deeply devastated her parents.

In the days following the tragedy, Vijay Antony released an emotional public statement expressing that a part of him had perished alongside her. He noted that he had started spending time with her memory and vowed to initiate all future good deeds in her honor.

body.h: Keeping Her Memory Alive Through Art
p: The family and the artist's professional team have continuously sought to keep Meera's presence alive within his creative endeavors. The Vijay Antony Film Corporation has frequently credited both Meera and Fatima as producers or presenters on various projects.
This ongoing tribute ensures that her name remains tied to the artistic milestones achieved by her father in the Tamil film industry.

body.h: About the Upcoming Film Appa Kutty
p: The emotional event served to promote Vijay Antony's latest starring vehicle, Appa Kutty, a father-daughter drama directed by Mu Maran. The movie also features Preethi Asrani playing a lead role alongside the actor.
The feature arrived in theaters on November 20, releasing amidst a competitive box office clash alongside other regional titles like OM and Aakasamlo Oka Tara.

At a promotional gathering for the film Appa Kutty, Fatima shared that her husband Vijay Antony has stopped wearing everyday shoes and continuously wears their late daughter Meera's watch following her passing in Chennai in 2023. The family continues to honor Meera's memory through both personal tributes and production credits on his creative projects.
